heard: A servant came from Saul's old house Named Ziba, standing in the dust The king asked if any kin remain Of Jonathan's line in this land A son with feet that could not walk Living far away from the ark The donkey's loaded with the bread Two hundred loaves are spread Raisins and fruit for the men Wine for the faint in the wilderness Then everything that belongs to Mephibosheth Is now yours to claim and to possess
